note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with an invented sales team and CRM export, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "lead-handoff-designer" skill. Here is our CRM lead export for the last 13 weeks. Design our MQL to SQL handoff: the stages, routing, the response-time agreement between marketing and sales, and what happens to rejected and stalled leads. Our win rate from opportunity to closed won is 30%.

business.name: Example Booking Software
business.what_it_sells: annual Business plan contracts for multi-staff service businesses, sold by inside sales

current_process: Every form fill with a business email becomes an MQL and is assigned round-robin to the three SDRs. There is no written response target and no fallback owner. The SDR qualifies on a call and books a meeting with the AE; that booking makes it an SQL. Reject reasons are a picklist with 'Other' and are not required. Nobody reviews no-shows.
hand_raise: a demo request, a pricing page chat, or a reply to sales
